author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.6.1 — Adds a configurable, comma-separated list of fault_code values to treat as normal rather than real faults (default 2103,2105 — an unconfirmed community lead suggests these may just mean charging/fully charged). Every nonzero fault_code is now also logged with full context (mode, chargeState, status, battery) regardless of whether it's ignored, to build an evidence trail for confirming what each code actually means.
